correctness.rationale: Degree-one leaves and open-neighbor tie inequalities yield exact forbidden triple 111 (minority) or 010 (majority), both with a hub-imposed half-density ceiling; the rim/leaf/hub reconstruction is bijective. Run compositions prove all-n counts; exact 4-state matrices yield the characteristic cubics. Minority density is strictly below half, giving a negligible discarded tail. Majority has a primitive 3/4-weight matrix with exact Perron root 3/2, density 1/2 and variance 1/3; its two distinct loop weights establish Fourier aperiodicity and the parity-sensitive n^-1/2 prefactor. Two independent replayable scripts check symbolic identities and finite populations.

value.rationale: The standard helm family exhibits sharply different asymptotic fixed-state regimes for two natural dynamics on identical topology and tie conventions. Exact finite counts, a noncritical tribonacci minority growth law and a critical majority growth of 3^(n/2)/sqrt(n) with a parity coefficient isolate the role of rim leaves and the global hub constraint. This is a motivated structural classification rather than an arbitrary short computation.
